background.source: Pyramids are magnificent structures that have fascinated people for centuries. These structures are characterized by their triangular outer surfaces that converge to a single step at the top, resembling the geometric shape of a pyramid. Pyramids can have various base shapes such as trilateral, quadrilateral, or any polygon shape with at least three outer triangular surfaces. They were built by civilizations all over the world as a way to commemorate and worship their deities, rulers, or important events. The distribution of weight in a pyramid's design allowed early civilizations to create stable monumental structures. The largest pyramid by volume is the Mesoamerican Great Pyramid of Cholula in Mexico, but the most famous ones are the Great Pyramid of Khufu and the Red Pyramid in Egypt, which are among the only remaining wonders of the ancient world.
background.target: The Great Wall of China is a legendary fortification that stretches over thousands of kilometers and was built as a defensive measure against various nomadic groups from the Eurasian steppe. It was constructed by different Chinese dynasties and served various purposes including controlling the borders, regulation and encouragement of trade as well as maintaining control over immigration and emigration. The Great Wall was an architectural marvel due to its watchtowers, troop barracks, garrison stations, signaling capabilities, and transportation corridor. Today, it is considered one of the most impressive defensive systems in history and an iconic symbol of China's rich cultural heritage.
